business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 Business section and repeated in the 10-K MD&A
business_model.claim: Hinge Health sells a technology platform for musculoskeletal (MSK) care that combines AI-powered motion tracking technology, a proprietary electrical nerve stimulation wearable device, and an AI-supported care team of licensed physical therapists, physicians, and board-certified health coaches.
quotes: Members receive personalized and automated MSK care through our AI-powered motion tracking technology and a proprietary electrical nerve stimulation wearable device, all designed and monitored by our AI-supported care team of licensed physical therapists, physicians, and board-certified health coaches.

business_model.claim: The company's primary clients are self-insured employers, and it also serves fully-insured health plan populations, Medicare Advantage populations, and federal insurance plans.
quotes: Our clients are primarily self-insured employers and include many of the nation's leading enterprises across a broad range of industries and sizes.
We also serve health plans' fully-insured and Medicare Advantage populations and federal insurance plans.

business_model.claim: Revenue is generated through an annual subscription model in which clients pay only for members that engage with the platform, and revenue is recognized ratably over the 12-month member subscription period.
quotes: We sell an annual subscription model, whereby clients only pay for members that engage with our programs. We primarily recognize revenue ratably over the 12 months after an eligible life becomes a member, and as such our revenue has historically been highly predictable.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-Q MD&A (H1 2026) and 10-K risk factors (FY2025)
business_model.claim: Most clients are billed through an engagement-based pricing model consisting of an annual upfront platform fee per member plus a fee per each completed billable session, with some clients on flat annual or milestone-based pricing.
quotes: Most of our clients are billed through an engagement-based pricing model based on an annual upfront platform fee per member plus a fee per each completed billable session.
we are implementing an alternative engagement-based pricing model in the near term based on member engagement, which may take more time and require more effort to implement than anticipated
